objective: Substantially close the visual gap to the architectural day/night references in the REAL interactive iOS shipping/QC scene, and remove jerky forklift/pallet handling. Retain stylized architectural abstraction, gain convincing physical surfaces, light and industrial detail. No rendered screenshot pasted over a fake interactive scene.

workstreams.motion: Reproduce the reported rough forklift pickup and pallet lift. Diagnose trajectory/timing/attachment/camera/render-frame issues rather than blindly add easing. Make pickup, lifting, carrying, turning, trailer placement, lowering and release physically coherent, continuous and appropriately slow; no teleport, foot/fork/pallet slide, penetration, floating loads, snapping camera or sudden state transitions. Fork mast/lift and carried object must share correct relative transforms; wheels and steer should support motion. Loaded truck departs only after forklift clears. Pause/resume, manual/follow transition and lifecycle must not jump. Use meaningful continuity and geometry clearance tests plus real-time and slow-motion recording. Instrument frame time on available simulator; distinguish simulated measurements from device FPS.
workstreams.art: Compare current iOS frames to both references at comparable framing. Priority deficits: simplistic worker silhouettes, box-like cab/forklift, uniform surfaces, low local detail, flat product highlights, abrupt light differences and weak grounding. Improve high-visibility models and proportions/bevels/normals, functional workshop equipment, services, layers of structure, credible clean factory details, industrial organization and contact shadows. Preserve premium cleanliness and original Salini product geometry; do not just add grime, noise or clutter. Improve a coherent bounded section deeply before expanding the campus.
workstreams.materials: Prefer free licensed scanned PBR materials (e.g. Poly Haven/ambientCG) with provenance, real physical scale and coherent albedo/normal/roughness/metalness, proper UVs and texel density. Target concrete, coated/galvanized steel, cab paint, rubber, pallet wood/cardboard and Salini mineral surfaces. Avoid merely applying one noise texture or turning roughness down globally. Detail geometry must support the material. Generated albedo/decals may be useful if unique material is missing; do not fake depth with baked specular/illumination in an albedo map or claim independently generated maps are physically consistent. Do not use Higgsfield credits. If Codex image generation is materially necessary, provide exact seamless/de-lit material spec in status/handoff, but continue all independent work and use proven assets as fallback.
workstreams.lighting: Use existing RealityKit 27 + Blender pipeline as baseline. Evaluate calibrated baked irradiance and probes, color management, soft directional shadows, local occlusion/contact, environment reflections on products, exposure consistency and day/night art direction. Compare matched-camera native output and offline target to locate actual bottleneck. Do not silently turn the app into a video, use postprocess blur to hide defects, or claim real-time ray tracing. Keep selected-object clarity, useful camera framing and labelled contextual trailer cutaway.
workstreams.engineering: Own all implementation, asset download/conversion/optimization, Blender baking, Swift fixes, meaningful tests, simulator build/install/visual loops, profiling and integration. Make multiple independent self-review passes until coherent, not a tiny patch followed by a question. Preserve working business board, manual camera, follow, day/night, accessibility and Reduce Motion. Keep content below glass controls legible. Bound asset loading/memory and avoid per-frame heavy work. No changes outside Salini or unrelated catalog/film/PDF flows.

acceptance: Visible material/light/model improvement in actual iOS daylight AND night screenshots, with baseline-matched camera comparisons; attractive offline render alone is insufficient.
Complete real-time loading/departure loop plus close-up pickup/setdown recording without visible snapping, sliding or intersections.
User selection, manual camera, following, zone buttons, pause, day/night and resumed app remain functional.
Relevant tests pass and release build compiles; performance claims measured and device limits explicit.
Complete source/assets/provenance committed and pushed. Handoff ready for independent Codex visual/code acceptance.
